what: A same-color circle (36px) is attached to the right of the pill button with a 4px overlap, and a gooey filter (blur 5 · alpha ×19 −9) joins the two so the seam melts like a droplet. On hover, the circle and the ↗ arrow on it shift 12px and rotate 45° to become →. The departing circle stretches out of the pill, looking about to snap yet still connected (.9s cubic-bezier(.135,.9,.15,1)). In the original this applies only at 1280 and up

options.[data-fx-part=goo]: Layer that applies the sticky filter — contains label and disc
options.[data-fx-part=arrow]: Arrow over a circle (outside the filter, sharp)
options.--fx-goo-bg · --fx-goo-ink: Pill/circle background and text color, default --kf-ink · --kf-bg
options.look: always: Interaction responds below 1280 too (the original only at 1280 and above)

use: View work
note: Text inside the filter layer is laid over the original graphic again (atop, blend) so it doesn’t blur. When the pill background is transparent (text-only link), the filter only smooths the circles.

from.where: shared.css .ms-btn (all pill buttons — ‹View work›, ‹Start a project›, ‹All services›)
